messages:
julia: customer-acme reporting truncated SSE streams when they open multiple client tabs behind Cloudflare Workers + ALB. Final event often cut mid-line, clients reconnect repeatedly and we see duplicate billing spikes. Repro on prod and staging.

sam: thanks — can you paste a minimal curl repro and the request id from one failed attempt? also whether upstream is http/2 or http/1.1?

customer-acme: here's a short reproducer we used:
```
curl -v -N 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?session=test' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream'
```
We see a 502 from the ALB after ~70s and the client gets a partial last "data:" line before reconnect. ALB access log excerpt: `target: i-0123abc target_status:502 elapsed_time:70.23`

eng-megan: sounds like an idle/probe half-close interaction combined with HTTP/2 multiplexing at Cloudflare. If CF coalesces streams, the ALB can think the connection is idle and send a FIN, which leads to a truncated chunk mid-frame.

sam: quick repro I ran locally (using CF in front) — sending a small heartbeat every 20s (single newline) reduces truncates but doesn't eliminate them. Dump from client side shows last frame truncated at the TCP seg boundary.

sam: snippet I used to simulate heartbeats (node):
```
res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
res.write(':keepalive\n\n'); // comment-frame as per SSE spec
setInterval(() => res.write('data: hello\n\n'), 20000);
```

ingrid: filed a ticket with Cloudflare, flagged possible HTTP/2 connection coalescing bug and provided packet captures. Asked customer to test bypassing CF (direct ALB cname) to confirm behavior.

eng-megan: notes / workaround suggestions:
- ensure stream sends some bytes < ALB idle timeout (ALB default 60s) — 20–25s heartbeats are safe.
- disable Cloudflare HTTP/2 connection pooling for this hostname (if possible) or test with http/1.1 to avoid multiplex coalescing.
- on Dedicated/private customers, recommend ALB/NLB idle timeout bump or use NLB + TCP passthrough where possible.
- avoid relying on trailing chunk semantics; treat last event as potentially partial and have client retry idempotently.

julia: action items — (1) ask customer to test direct-to-alb repro and report results, (2) share our heartbeat code snippet and recommend 15–25s comment-frame heartbeats, (3) follow up on Cloudflare ticket and post CF response here.

ops-bot: created support-esc-#4521 for customer-acme and linked packet captures.

customer-acme: we'll try direct ALB tonight and report back. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
